name: Lanathos
description: A scarred older human storyteller living among the leonin who tells the tale of the Champion of the Sun.

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Brimaz for help finding his friend Elspeth, and Brimaz points him to Lanathos.
timeline.quote: You should talk to Lanathos," said Brimaz.

timeline.summary: Lanathos tells the leonin the tale of Polukranos and the Champion of the Sun, who slays the hydra at the Plateau of the Four Winds.
timeline.quote: Polukranos, eater of poleis, beloved of the gods, was no more.

timeline.summary: Ajani introduces himself to Lanathos and asks about Elspeth; Lanathos eagerly asks where Ajani is from.
timeline.quote: There are people across the mountains? Leonin and human?

timeline.summary: Lanathos explains that the Champion of the Sun is a title, and that the latest champion killed Polukranos about a month ago.
timeline.quote: Very recently. During the Silence of the gods. A month ago, perhaps slightly more.

timeline.summary: Ajani realizes the latest Champion may be Elspeth, and Lanathos says she was seen at Akros, besieged by minotaurs.
timeline.quote: After she slew Polukranos, the Champion was spotted at Akros, which has been besieged by a horde of minotaurs.

relations.note: He seems to have the king's trust and tells stories to the leonin.
relations.quote: But I seem to have King Brimaz's trust, and that's enough for most people.

pages_say.description: A scarred older human storyteller living among the leonin who tells the tale of the Champion of the Sun.
